identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route operators to canonical Runtime v3 service control

values.goal: Make the current-generation Rust CSM route the sole documented permanent Runtime control path and prevent legacy shell commands from claiming authority.
values.required_outcome: Operators receive accurate canonical start, status, stop, reload, ownership, and identity guidance, while legacy CSMctl Runtime verbs refuse with a concise migration message.
declared_scope: START_CSM_RUNBOOK canonical command and path correction
small deterministic routing and docs guards
authority_boundary: No changes to canonical Rust ownership semantics
No live Runtime or launchd mutation
No cloud provider agent model edge or Observatory UI changes
operator_constraints: Prefer a direct refusal over delegation complexity
